Alex (People Ops): All-hands Wednesday 11:00am PT. Please add short agenda bullets or questions by Tuesday 5pm. We'll record.

Priya (CEO): I'll give a 5-min strategic update and highlight two customer wins.

Diego (Product): Demo of Dedicated autopilot (10m). tagging @Mina for runtime notes.

Mina (Eng): I'll cover two engineering callouts: batching default changes and a debug-log retention policy update for Dedicated.

Alex (People Ops): Draft agenda: 11:00 intro + strategy (Priya), 11:06 Product demo (Diego), 11:16 Eng callouts (Mina), 11:25 CS highlight (Sam), 11:30 Q&A, 11:45 Close + takeaways.

Sam (CS): I'll share the pilot customer metric and one support ask.

reminder-bot: Calendar invite posted -> https://calendar.example.com/event/3620010000 (Zoom link included).

Cal (Platform): I'll add a slide with p95 improvements and a note on quantization tests.

Diego (Product): Request: infra/plat on standby for Q&A.

Mina (Eng): confirmed. Also CLI snippet we can paste if asked about batching:
```
redwoodctl set batching.profile conservative
redwoodctl restart inference
```

Alex (People Ops): Quick note: retention default will be shortened to 30 days; Dedicated customers can request extensions via support. Add to slides.

Priya (CEO): TL;DR for those who miss it: 1) Autopilot demo + rollout plan; 2) debug-log retention default to 30 days; 3) console dark-mode opt-in; 4) p95 latency improvements. Slides+recording after meeting.

(After meeting) reminder-bot: Recording + slides: https://videos.example.com/recordings/3620010000 and https://drive.example.com/3620010000-slides.pdf

Alex (People Ops): Post-meeting TL;DR: Autopilot canary next week, retention default shortened to 30 days (Dedicated can extend), dark-mode opt-in live, p95 down ~16% after KV cache. Follow-ups and owners in the shared doc.

Mina (Eng): RFC link for retention: https://docs.redwood.example.org/rfcs/retention-2026

Diego (Product): I'll post rollout checklist and owners.

Alex (People Ops): Thanks everyone. If you had a question that wasn't answered, DM me and I'll route it. :speech_balloon:
